attrs.title: A browser pane beside the conversation.
A native messaging bridge to Chrome (Hacker News 2026-04-23 reported it installed undisclosed).
Claude Code on the web: cloud sessions on GitHub repos that keep running with the laptop off.
Sidebar of the app's own Code sessions; sessions started in a terminal come in through /resume in the prompt box, not automatically. Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop, market.md 3.1.
Cowork, which runs a local VM (an open issue reports about 10 GB).
A diff view of the session's changes.
Message a task in the Claude app and Desktop spawns a Code session (Pro and Max only). Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/mobile.
A file editor pane.
An integrated terminal pane.
The Code tab in the Claude phone app (Remote Control client). Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/mobile.
Model and effort menus with shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+I, Ctrl+Shift+E).
An OS notification when a session finishes or needs a decision.

Drive a local Claude Code session from claude.ai/code or the Claude app: QR pairing, images and files, push when a task finishes or needs a decision, reconnect after sleep. Needs the machine on and claude running; API keys are not supported; not end to end encrypted. Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control.
Scheduled tasks.
A keyboard shortcut cheat sheet (Ctrl+/).
Side chat (Ctrl+;) that can read the main thread.
Split panes with drag and drop layout.
Sessions on SSH hosts and in WSL.
A usage ring showing plan usage.
Tasks can start in a git worktree (market.md cites Claude Desktop with Codex, Conductor and Emdash as doing this).
